# Project Design Context

Hand-authored 2026-08-07. `21st init --design-context` auto-detected nothing here — this
project has no `package.json` on the client, no Tailwind config and no component registry,
so every fact below was read out of the source directly. Do **not** run
`--design-context --refresh`: it will overwrite this with empty values.

## Project

- Name: ShopXtra
- Product type: E-commerce (organic wellness — electrolytes, shampoo, coffee, cosmetics; Pakistan, PKR, COD)
- Stack: HTML + CSS + vanilla JS + Bootstrap 5 (client), Express + Postgres (server)
- Color mode: light only
- Density: comfortable

## Sources

- Tokens: `client/css/style.css` (`:root`, lines 14–64)
- Components: `client/js/layout.js`, `client/js/home.js`, `client/js/api.js`
- Assets: `client/assets`
- Instructions: `CLAUDE.md`

## Components

- Installed: none (no component library)
- Preferred primitives: Bootstrap 5 utilities and grid, plus hand-written classes in `client/css/style.css`
- Patterns: `category-tile`, `trust-band-item`, `review-card-v2`, `certification-card`,
  `faq-accordion` (native `<details>`), `section-head` + `section-head-link`

## Tokens

Forest-green organic palette. Variable *names* are legacy (`--tea-pink`, `--plum`,
`--dusty-rose`) from an earlier pink "Soft Tea" theme; only the values were changed, so
ignore what the names imply.

| Token | Value | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `--ivory-blush` | `#F7F9F6` | page background |
| `--paper` | `#FFFFFF` | cards, surfaces |
| `--sand` | `#EEF3E8` | muted surface |
| `--tea-pink` | `#1F5C3E` | primary (buttons, nav, footer) |
| `--ink-hover` | `#164A30` | primary hover |
| `--plum` | `#12291E` | ink / headings |
| `--dusty-rose` | `#8FD19E` | mint accent |
| `--gold` | `#E6A935` | prices, CTA highlight |
| `--muted` / `--muted-body` | `#6B7970` / `#4C5A52` | secondary text |
| `--hairline` / `--hairline-strong` | `#E4E9DF` / `#D7E0D1` | borders |

Category tints: electrolytes `#E7F0DD`, coffee `#EFE7DB`, shampoo `#DFEEE7`, cosmetics `#F0E4E6`.

- Typography: **Montserrat** everywhere, self-hosted variable woff2 (400–900). Headings 600–800, body 400.
  `CLAUDE.md` claims Newsreader/Cormorant + Instrument Sans — that was never implemented. Trust the CSS.
- Radius: `--radius-sm/md/lg` are all **`0`**. The shipped design is deliberately square.
- Shadows: `--shadow-soft`, `--shadow-soft-lg`, `--shadow-lift` — all tinted with the ink green, never pure black.
- Motion: GSAP + ScrollTrigger, driven by `data-reveal` / `data-reveal-group` attributes in `client/js/motion.js`.

## Constraints

### Must

- Plain HTML/CSS/JS only — no React, no JSX, no Tailwind, no client build step
- Style from the existing CSS custom properties, not new hard-coded hex values
- Bump the `?v=` query on the `style.css` `<link>` in every page whenever `style.css` changes
- Responsive down to mobile — Pakistan is a mobile-heavy market
- Visible keyboard focus states on every interactive element
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`
- Prices in PKR, formatted `Rs 1,450`

### Avoid

- Rounded corners — the radius tokens are `0` on purpose
- The pink/plum "Soft Tea" palette described in `CLAUDE.md` — the live brand is forest green
- Supplier marketing images with baked-in headline text or competitor watermarks as hero/tile art
- Decorative gradients, glassmorphism, oversized display headlines

## Decisions

- **2026-08-07** — Category tiles use curated `/assets/hero` photography rather than product
  marketing graphics: the 5/4 tile crop slices through supplier text baked into those images.
  (`client/js/home.js`)
